camel_example: aliyun bailian POST /llm-3z7uw7fwz0vxxxx/datacenter/category/ --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --body CategoryName=产品清单&CategoryType=UNSTRUCTURED --version 2023-12-29 --force
description_en: Creates a category in a specified workspace for classifying and managing files. A maximum of 500 categories can be created in each workspace
description_zh: 在指定的业务空间中创建一个类目，用于分类和管理文件。每个业务空间最多创建500个类目
kebab_example: aliyun bailian add-category --workspace-id llm-3z7uw7fwz0vxxxx --category-name '产品清单' --category-type UNSTRUCTURED --api-version 2023-12-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddCategory

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. The category is created in this workspace. For more information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html. The bailian 2023-12-29 version does not provide an API for listing workspaces. Obtain the workspace ID from the Model Studio console before calling this operation
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间 ID，即在该业务空间中新增类目。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html。bailian 2023-12-29 当前未提供用于枚举业务空间的 API，调用前需在百炼控制台获取业务空间 ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The category name. The name must be 1 to 20 characters in length and can contain characters in the Unicode letter category, including letters, Chinese characters, and digits. The name can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 类目名称。长度为 1~20 个字符，支持 Unicode 中 letter 分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文和数字等）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: category_name

parameters.help_en:
The category type. Valid values:
UNSTRUCTURED: category
parameters.help_zh:
类目类型。取值范围：
UNSTRUCTURED：类目
parameters.name: category_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent category. The new category is created under this parent category. If this parameter is left empty, a first-level category is created
parameters.help_zh: 父类目的类目 ID。在此父类目下创建新类目，此值为空时创建一级类目
parameters.name: parent_category_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the data connector (Connector). Obtain this value from the Model Studio console
parameters.help_zh: 所属数据连接（Connector）的实例id，请到百炼控制台获取
parameters.name: connector_id
